# Kursvending eller flere dårlige nyheder forude?

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-11-23  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Danish Millionærklubben episode (EuroInvestor, 2026-11-23) looks at last week's sharp sell-off, which started as a rotation and turned into a broad sell-off. The panel blames fears of an AI bubble, the Nvidia scandal (SEC accounting probe, interim CEO), concerns about AI financing (Oracle), a hawkish Fed and US political shifts that could slow data-centre build-outs. The guests think the fundamentals (earnings, order books, the 2027 outlook) are still intact and that the market is not expensive. They favour quality and electrification/infrastructure names such as TSMC, Schneider, NKT and ABB, plus DSV, while saying it is too early to call the bottom.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 SU — Schneider Electric | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Morten holds it and buys more on weakness; says the AI-fear sell-off and acquisition reaction are overdone. Michelle also positive.

#### Reasoning

Guest Morten Gregersen: a high-quality company strongly placed in AI infrastructure and electrification. The grid has been underinvested for a long time and has political support, giving years of double-digit earnings growth. He is rebalancing into the dip. Michelle agrees the electrification case holds whatever happens to the AI hype.

#### Sell Triggers

- if data-centre capex collapses
- if electrification spending slows
- if the acquisition destroys value

> *"Jeg synes, det er overdrevet, og jeg synes, det er et højkvalitetselskab, der er virkelig stærkt positioneret."*

---

### 🟢 TSM — TSMC | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Morten finds it attractive after a 9% ADR drop; it builds AI infrastructure as a technology and cost leader.

#### Reasoning

Guest Morten: a long-held position. TSMC is the technology and cost leader and does not depend on which chip designer wins market share, so a shift away from Nvidia is not a threat. He sees chip demand staying robust for years, and the data centres already under construction run into 2028. Taiwan/China geopolitics is the main risk.

#### Sell Triggers

- if China moves on Taiwan
- if chip demand falls sharply
- if the AI investment wave collapses in 2027

> *"Så på de her niveauer med de udsigter, og igen, jeg har svært ved at forestille mig, at efterspørgselen ændrer sig voldsomt i en negativ retning for chips"*

---

### 🟢 DSV — DSV | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Michelle would start buying in small steps and add as synergy visibility improves; Morten holds it, citing high cash flow and self-help.

#### Reasoning

Guest Michelle Nørgaard: the stock fell with the market, not on company news. The Schenker integration is improving, and synergies should materialise in 2027-28. Guest Morten: impressive execution, and a return to organic growth plus better conversion ratios would lift cash flow, which the price does not reflect. The asset-light model handles cycles well. It is cyclical, so a recession is a risk.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a recession hits freight volumes
- if Schenker synergies fail to materialise
- if problems in the road division persist

> *"så synes jeg altså, jeg ville måske godt kunne begynde i hvert fald at dyppe togen i den her"*

---

### 🟢 NKT — NKT | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Lars wants NKT or ABB back in the Millionærklubben portfolio; Michelle holds it long term on the grid-upgrade case.

#### Reasoning

Host/analyst Lars Persson thinks he sold NKT too early last year and wants it back in the club portfolio. Michelle has held it for a long time. Grid upgrades, the green transition and electric vehicles create large structural demand for cables, whatever happens to AI.

#### Sell Triggers

- if grid investment programmes are cut
- if political opposition delays build-outs

> *"den eller NKT skal i hvert fald være med i Millionærklubbens portefølje igen"*

---

### 🟠 ABBN — ABB | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

The stock is in a falling trend; on Lars's candidate bench, to buy when the trend turns.

#### Reasoning

Technical analyst Lars Persson checks ABB almost daily and will buy for the Millionærklubben portfolio once the downtrend reverses. He sees the electrification case intact but wants confirmation from the trend first.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the downtrend continues
- if grid and data-centre investment slows

> *"Fordi når nu den her trend vender, så skal jeg da helt sikkert have den med igen."*

---

### 🟠 VALMT — Valmet | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Lars would like to own some Valmet and is looking at it.

#### Reasoning

Lars Persson said briefly that he would like to own Valmet but gave no detailed thesis.

> *"Jeg har også lidt, kunne også godt tænke mig lidt valmet måske"*

---

### 🟡 V — Visa | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Morten is very happy with the holding; it delivered and diversified risk during the rotation.

#### Reasoning

Guest Morten Gregersen named Visa as a holding he is pleased with: it delivered good returns and diversified risk in this market.

---

### 🟡 SAP — SAP | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Morten is happy with the holding; it delivered well and diversified risk.

#### Reasoning

Guest Morten listed SAP among the holdings that did well and helped diversify through the rotation.

---

### 🟡 1299 — AIA Group | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Hong Kong insurer that Morten is happy with; it delivered and diversified risk.

#### Reasoning

Guest Morten named AIA Group as a good performer and diversifier in his quality portfolio.
